title: Haru y Yuki · animación
description: Haru and Yuki's rig and gait (src/cats.ts, src/cat-gait.ts): two-bone legs placed by inverse kinematics, paws planted while they bear weight, a walk, a trot and a gallop chosen by their own speed, sitting, crouching, leaping and hiding, with breathing, blinks, ear flicks, glances and a four-segment tail. On Nuria's street following the party, then in a fight with Papagato.

steps.eval: { const c = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Reparto').children.find(c => c.name === 'Haru').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: c.y + .25, z: c.z }, 1.4); }

steps.caption: Left waiting a moment beside Gerard, Haru and Yuki sit: rear down, hind paws tucked, tails round their paws

steps.each: if (window.frame === 0) { const p = window.gerard.game.position, at = { x: Math.round(p.x), z: Math.round(p.z) }; for (const [dx, dz] of [[0, -6], [0, 6], [6, 0], [-6, 0], [0, -4], [4, 0]]) { try { window.gerard.game.standAt({ x: at.x + dx, z: at.z + dz }); break; } catch {} } } { const c = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Reparto').children.find(c => c.name === 'Haru').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: c.y + .25, z: c.z }, 2.2); }
steps.caption: Gerard is suddenly a few metres on: they get up and gallop after him (hinds, then fores, body low), ease through a trot, stop beside him and, after a moment, sit

steps.each: { const c = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Reparto').children.find(c => c.name === 'Haru').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: c.y + .25, z: c.z }, 1.6); }
steps.caption: At home after the mission: Haru strolls at a walk (left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore), stops and sits until the next stroll

steps.eval: { const c = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Haru').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: c.y + .3, z: c.z }, 1.2); }

steps.caption: Haru on guard in a fight: head low and forward, ears pricked, the tip of her tail twitching, breathing

steps.eval: { const c = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Yuki').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: c.y + .3, z: c.z }, 1.2); }

steps.caption: Yuki sits behind Gerard: she glances round, blinks, an ear flicks

steps.eval: { const h = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Haru').getPosition(), d = window.gerard.game.fighterAt('dog-0'); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: (h.x + d.x) / 2, y: .5, z: (h.z + d.z) / 2 }, 2.6); }

steps.caption: Zarpazo de Haru: crouched, she springs with her forelegs reaching and hind legs pushing back, lands low to swat, and hops back

steps.eval: { const y = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Yuki').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: y.x + .1, y: y.y + .3, z: y.z - .2 }, 1.5); }

steps.caption: Yuki se esconde: she gets up, slinks behind Gerard pressed to the floor, ears flat and tail tucked, and goes back to sit
